channel.title: AI GridWatch — Pennsylvania data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Pennsylvania, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Olyphant: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 6-month moratorium on new data center development, 4-3. Triggered a wave of similar actions across Lackawanna, Luzerne, and Chester counties

item.title: East Whiteland Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 180-day moratorium — board declared parts of data center zoning 'substantively invalid' and launched curative amendment. Developer Green Fig withdrew 1.7M sq ft application in May after sustained public opposition

item.title: Pennsylvania: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: SB 1345 — would allow municipalities to impose 18-month moratoriums. Passed Senate Rules & Exec Nominations Committee 13-4. Three competing state bills range from 180 days to 3 years. Not yet enacted
